services.desc: Our yoga instructors are talented, experienced, and provide excellent service as they cater to individual needs in a group setting. Drop-in anytime to one of our yoga classes as they are included in all our gym membership packages! In her classes, she emphasizes the importance of flow. Expect to be challenged and recharged!
